Emergency Slide Deploys on New Air Force One, Delaying President's Trip

An emergency slide deployed accidentally on the new Air Force One aircraft while President Donald Trump was preparing to board for a trip to Dallas. The incident occurred on the tarmac, causing a delay to the President's departure. The aircraft is described as a Qatari-gifted jet. The cause of the deployment is under investigation, with one report suggesting it was accidental.
